title: Minimizing 0-dimensional currents vanish
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and T ∈ 𝒟_0(U) minimizing in U in the sense of the contract's IsMinimizingIn T U (Simon 7.1.1): T is integer multiplicity, and M_W(T) ≤ M_W(S) for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U and every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_0(U) such that spt(S − T) is a compact subset of U ∩ W (the condition ∂S = ∂T is vacuous in degree 0). Then T = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T U → T = 0
